page.notes: Hebrew and Greek lines are transcribed with vowel points as far as legible; the vowel pointing on the Hebrew forms in the first heading and in the numeral lines is faint and may be imperfect. Words in the Latin paragraphs marked with a short bar or tilde (e.g. "pekadtèm", "Activa") are copied as printed; the initial capital of "Activa" is uncertain, possibly "Actiua".
